limitations: Most Hotspawn LoL matches are low-tier regional/online events. No verified public betting line exists for them, so their picks are left blank and they are listed under Flagged for Review. Per the project rules, no probability is invented for these matches.

Pinnacle lists professional LoL markets (e.g., Worlds, EMEA Masters) but its public guest API exposes no price endpoint (matchups/<id>/markets -> 404, verified 2026-10-21). Pinnacle is therefore used only to confirm a match carries a pro-book line.
Polymarket currently lists per-match markets only for its covered LoL events (Worlds 2026, EMEA Masters). Matches outside those events have no per-match market.

Kalshi's KXLOL series currently contains tournament futures only (no per-match markets, verified 2026-10-21). Futures are used only as labeled inputs to our derived estimate for matches where both teams have futures in the same event.

The Hotspawn backend endpoint is unofficial (reverse-engineered from the public lobby page, which serves team logos from the same host). If Hotspawn changes the host, refreshes fail and the site shows the last good data with a STALE marker instead of inventing new matches.
Probabilities are market mids at fetch time and move over time. Every number on the site carries the fetch timestamp from the manifest; the data refreshes automatically every 4 hours.
Derived estimates (our own lines) use a transparent ratio model on tournament-futures mids. They are not book lines, are labeled as such, and are duplicated on the Flagged for Review page.
